lane: SQL: AI switches for Tarot, Daily and Astrology preview; move pgvector out of public
goal: Two small Singapore migrations from section 4b. (1) Admin emergency switches for tarot_reading, daily_insight and astrology_report (AD-10 lists Tarot and Daily missing; the 10/11 guard reads daily_insight and astrology_report but no row can be set yet). Tarot AI starts honouring its switch. (2) Security Advisor 08/11 warning extension_in_public: move the vector extension to the extensions schema.
successCriteria: Migration 20261111090000 widens the allowed feature names, inserts the three rows (idempotent) and replaces set_ai_feature_switch with the same rules (ai.manage, reason 3-200 characters, audit log).
Migration 20261111090100 creates schema extensions if missing and moves the vector extension there; embedding columns and indexes keep working.
ai-tarot-reading answers 503 feature_paused when its switch is off, before the limit and the model; the app already shows the resting message.
Admin AI switches page lists the three new features.
Both migrations run on PGlite (PostgreSQL 17) with assertions; Tarot passes deno check; Admin checks pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No migration is applied by the agent: the Owner runs db push on Singapore after approving.
supabase/migration-ledger.json describes the old QA project and is not changed.
